modifications.description: Required when decision == 'adjust_stop' (carries new_stop_price) or decision == 'adjust_take_profit' (carries new_tp_price). Prices in absolute USD. Exactly the key matching the decision; never both.

expendability.description: Daily-sweep reviews ONLY (review_trigger == 'event:daily_sweep'): how expendable this slot is relative to the rest of the book. 1 = last to sacrifice (thesis intact, dated catalyst ahead); 5 = first to sacrifice (thesis weak/stale). Omit entirely on non-sweep reviews.

expendability_reason.description: Daily-sweep reviews ONLY: one line justifying the expendability score. Omit on non-sweep reviews.
